title: DEF CON 23 - Chris Rock - I Will Kill You
summary: A DEF CON 23 talk showing how weak controls in electronic death registration systems let someone virtually kill a person and obtain a real death certificate, with consequences for their identity and life.
why: HN repeatedly recommends it whenever fake deaths, identity verification or records fraud come up, praising how easy the attack seemed.

quote.text: Really eye opening, and potentially devastating if it's done to you.
